skills.trigger: When evaluating a chest X-ray for acute respiratory symptoms and distinguishing pneumothorax from other pleural or parenchymal pathologies.
steps: Inspect the lung periphery for a visible visceral pleural line separated from the chest wall by a radiolucent space devoid of vascular markings to confirm pneumothorax.
Assess the lateral chest wall for irregular opacities or increased density along the pleural surface to identify associated pleural thickening.
Differentiate from aspergilloma by confirming the absence of a mobile intracavitary mass with an air crescent sign within a pre-existing cavity.
Differentiate from bullous disease by ensuring the lucency is extra-pulmonary (outside the lung markings) rather than intra-pulmonary thin-walled cysts.
